$comment: One table of writes and the plan each must get from the target node's own attributes, driven through BOTH runtimes: tests/unit/test_write_plan.py and packages/server-node/test/write-plan.test.mjs call planWrite / plan_write on each case and assert the same plan. `facts` is what the node's attributes said (NodeClass, DataType resolved to a built-in, ValueRank, ArrayDimensions, AccessLevel, UserAccessLevel, enumeration states, two-state labels) or null when they could not be read; `engineering` is the existing EngineeringUnits/EURange/InstrumentRange record. A `send` plan is what is converted and written — `data_type` null means the type comes from the node's current value, as it always did, and `array` null means array-ness comes from wherever the type came from. A `skip` is that node's record, nothing sent to it, the rest of the batch unaffected. A `refuse` is the whole batch, nothing written. Every sentence is from contract/tools.json -> writeSkips or errors.
